rows.title: Clean accepted implementation base
rows.setup: Dirty canonical branch plus exact accepted executable commit.
rows.stimulus: Create the implementation worktree through the authorized repository workflow.
rows.expected: Worktree HEAD equals accepted base and source-delta receipt names imported SDD bytes.
rows.wrong_effect_absent: No reset, clean, rebase, overwrite, or mutation of user dirty work.

rows.title: Complexity-budget inventory
rows.setup: Exact candidate source and package manifest.
rows.stimulus: Inventory processes, entry points, dependencies, durable stores, provider SDKs, and MCP tools against v0.5.
rows.expected: Only the allowed operator/profile/planner/admission additions exist.
rows.wrong_effect_absent: No new daemon, state DB, credential store, provider client, broker, or MCP back-channel.

rows.title: Cutover plan is read-only
rows.setup: Disposable v5 DB with absent/present WAL/SHM plus filesystem and SQLite-authorizer write/checkpoint canaries; stopped owner.
rows.stimulus: Run stdout-only cutover plan and all read-only status/verify commands while capturing stdout, stderr and every canary.
rows.expected: Exactly one canonical plan plus trailing newline appears on stdout, diagnostics stay on stderr, observations/target are bound, and SQLite/runtime-home remain read-only/query-only.
rows.wrong_effect_absent: No --output path, WAL checkpoint, temp/snapshot/authority file, DB/WAL/SHM create/delete/truncate, service/token/network/provider mutation by the command; operator shell redirection is external and its bytes are revalidated by apply.

rows.title: Owner and nonterminal admission
rows.setup: Rows for active supervisor, replacement owner, live operation, live ticket, and clean terminal baseline.
rows.stimulus: Apply the same valid plan to each variant.
rows.expected: Exclusive cutover lock excludes supervisor startup; replacement owner must reconcile an unmatched prepared/DB/marker tuple before any apply, restore, or Ready publication.
rows.wrong_effect_absent: No shared/exclusive overlap, raw-PID authority, lock gap, second owner, DB write, or Ready record.

rows.title: SQLite snapshot and WAL assurance
rows.setup: V5 DB under WAL mode with committed WAL and SHM variants; plan canaries followed by exclusive-lock apply.
rows.stimulus: Run zero-write plan, then explicit apply through SQLite backup completion; open and compare backup.
rows.expected: Plan only observes sidecars; verified standalone backup includes committed WAL pages; restore receipt carries strict DB/WAL/SHM disposition and integrity/FK.
rows.wrong_effect_absent: No plan checkpoint/write, raw live-file copy, SHM-as-business-evidence, silent sidecar deletion, partial snapshot/marker, or source mutation.

rows.title: Atomic v6 DDL and attestation
rows.setup: Valid prepared marker and exact v5 fixture.
rows.stimulus: Inject faults before DDL, between objects, before attestation, and before/after commit.
rows.expected: Observed DB is complete v5 or complete attested v6 only.
rows.wrong_effect_absent: No partial v6 objects or unattested committed v6 state.

rows.title: Cutover idempotency and conflict
rows.setup: Committed receipt and prepared-old-DB images plus exact/mutated command, plan, profile, candidate, history-tip/current variants.
rows.stimulus: Rerun exact apply/initialize/reconcile and every changed binding.
rows.expected: Exact completed rerun returns existing bytes; prepared-old-DB reconcile returns ABORT_OR_APPLY_REQUIRED with zero write; changed/forked bindings conflict.
rows.wrong_effect_absent: No silent apply/abort, duplicate migration/history/attestation/marker, current overwrite, or changed-byte acceptance.

rows.title: Cutover crash reconciliation
rows.setup: Crash images at prepared, DB transaction/commit, profile, immutable-history publication, derived-current replacement and terminal-marker boundaries.
rows.stimulus: Run exact-input and changed-input cutover/runtime status and reconcile; use explicit abort/apply only at classified pre-DB state.
rows.expected: Reconcile writes only the deterministic missing suffix after proof; history-committed states repair current/marker once; ambiguity/changed input remains recovery-required.
rows.wrong_effect_absent: No blind migration/init replay, implicit abort/apply, history fork/deletion, supervisor start, downgrade, duplicate generation/epoch, or lost evidence.

rows.title: Rollback frontier
rows.setup: Prepared-only, DB-committed, history-published, current-repaired, Ready-published and first-v6-write states.
rows.stimulus: Request snapshot restore in each state.
rows.expected: Restore is accepted only before DB/history/runtime frontier; snapshot replacement and sidecar disposition are verified.
rows.wrong_effect_absent: No restore after v6/history commit or use, history/current rewind/deletion, raw copy over live DB, stale WAL replay, premature sidecar deletion, or erased evidence.

rows.title: All fourteen strict documents validate canonically
rows.setup: Generate valid and invalid fixtures for fourteen operator/profile/evaluation schemas, including prepared/terminal markers and paired admission.
rows.stimulus: Validate required fields, bounds, canonical order, self digests, acyclic inner/outer construction, mode/backend cross-fields and duplicate-key rejection with project and independent Draft 2020-12 validators.
rows.expected: Both validators agree; every valid fixture round-trips byte-stably and plan→prepared→receipt→terminal construction is acyclic.
rows.wrong_effect_absent: No omitted/extra/defaulted property, digest fixed point, marker/receipt swap, invalid backend/reference pair, zero deadline policy, or duplicate-key acceptance.

rows.title: Fail-closed Ready publication
rows.setup: Exact v6 profile plus absent/stale/malformed history chain/current/marker/registry/profile/intent/adapter/route/grant variants and runtime/listener/discovery/grant/operation canaries.
rows.stimulus: Run activation preflight and attempt supervisor startup.
rows.expected: Only an unbranched history whose tip equals current and committed markers permits host construction/runtime allocation; Ready follows final recheck.
rows.wrong_effect_absent: No runtime increment, pointer repair outside reconcile, listener, Ready, issuer, grant, operation, credential access or provider send on rejection.

rows.title: Capability truth derives from runtime objects
rows.setup: Complete profile plus native/caller/reference, missing, stale, contract-mismatching and forbidden artifact-put caller factory variants.
rows.stimulus: Instantiate factories and derive capability/readback rows.
rows.expected: Exact allowed native/caller factories project configured/admission-usable rows; exact reference projects configured/reference-only/null identity+generation/unknown but is unusable; artifact-put caller registration rejects; missing/stale/factory-unbound projects unconfigured.
rows.wrong_effect_absent: No configured truth from profile booleans, arbitrary import, fake identity, stale generation, reference admission, observation-tier mapping, or v6-owner-incompatible method/backend pair.

rows.title: Activation status is read-only exact readback
rows.setup: Unconfigured/active/degraded/recovery roots with absent, stale, exact, forked, missing or rolled-back activation history, derived current pointer and committed markers plus canaries.
rows.stimulus: Run activation status repeatedly.
rows.expected: Strict self-digested readback names the exact known profile/intent/attestation/history tip/current equality, activation/runtime generations, grant/factory/capability evidence and reason state.
rows.wrong_effect_absent: No DB/file write, current repair outside explicit reconcile, grant mint, service start, token refresh, credential lookup or provider call.

rows.title: Per-profile activation history has one durable CAS tip
rows.setup: Cutover/fresh roots with absent history, generation N/N+1/equal/lower, stale prior, concurrent epochs, ABA, fork/missing/partially deleted records with retained marker/current evidence, stale/rolled-back current, marker disagreement, and crashes around history/current/marker publication.
rows.stimulus: Run apply/initialize/status/exact reconcile under stable lock; restart operators/supervisors at every boundary.
rows.expected: Immutable history publication commits one strict successor; current is derived/repaired to the unique tip; exact replay converges; terminal marker follows once; cold start rejects every visible fork/partial-deletion/pointer-rollback inconsistency.
rows.wrong_effect_absent: No equal/lower reuse, stale-tip overwrite, fork, missing-link acceptance, history deletion, current rollback authority, Ready/grant before chain/current/marker equality, or blind CAS replay.
rows.evidence_class: fault-injected local-file authority CAS integration matrix

rows.title: Scoped grant publication
rows.setup: Inactive/active profiles, strict grant-set policies, issued server records, and changed principal/session/generation/profile/history/capability/route/grant-set/budget/TTL client contexts.
rows.stimulus: Mint bounded grants then validate every exact and mutated mutation context through issuer lookup.
rows.expected: Only an active current server-issued record matching all host/context bindings authorizes the exact capability and bounded budgets/deadline.
rows.wrong_effect_absent: No client self-asserted digest authority, wildcard principal/session, stale runtime/history, wrong session/capability, over-budget/expired/revoked grant, or operation row.

rows.title: Activation performs no inference
rows.setup: Provider-send canary and valid activation profile.
rows.stimulus: Verify/start/status/stop activated supervisor without job submission.
rows.expected: Activation/readback completes locally.
rows.wrong_effect_absent: No operation, ticket, model journal row, credential access, or provider send.

rows.title: Frozen grant_ids resolution, TTL domain and v8 wire precedence
rows.setup: Generate coherent sorted-unique multi-grant contexts plus missing/revoked/expired/mixed-set/identity/ceiling/duplicate-capability variants; test max_ttl_ms 999, 1000 and 900000; include current adapter-health loss and retired factory drift.
rows.stimulus: Validate grant-set policy, resolve issuer records and run pre-operation admission.
rows.expected: Only TTL 1000..900000 and coherent records produce one capability union and bounded deadline/budgets; authority mismatches serialize as frozen-v8 GRANT_DENIED before availability; only same-generation health loss is CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE; no issued_grant_record_shape_digest field exists.
rows.wrong_effect_absent: No impossible policy, client-authored authority, last-record wins, mixed union, duplicate ambiguity, AUTHORITY_DENIED wire literal, non-recomputable shape digest, operation row or provider send.

rows.title: Durable root planner phases
rows.setup: Caller-delegated initial/correction/recovery/finalizer null-cell suspensions; unique waiting-external operation events; deterministic receipts; owner-schema and cell-table access canaries.
rows.stimulus: Advance each phase through settlement, pending→prepared, crash/rebind via prepared→prepared, then atomic prepared→consumed plus directive mutation.
rows.expected: Each predecessor event/owner/ticket is exact; a current attempt/fence/generation may take over only after the old lease/dispatch authority is dead, then consumption and directive projection commit exactly once; synchronous planner and both cell-bound-table canaries stay zero.
rows.wrong_effect_absent: No latest-attempt inference, inline call, ordinal alias, synthetic cell, planner cell-bound access, live-owner takeover, consumed-without-projection, duplicate directive, frozen-DDL edit or sidecar authority.

rows.title: Caller start-only deadlock prevention without schema exception
rows.setup: Caller-delegated job under the frozen v8 execute schema.
rows.stimulus: Submit start_only=false and start_only=true variants.
rows.expected: False always rejects before operation creation; true returns durable accepted/waiting state. No duplex-driver exception exists.
rows.wrong_effect_absent: No blocking deadlock, hidden ticket, schema widening, duplex escape hatch or operation on rejected input.

rows.title: External wait releases attempt lease
rows.setup: Fake clock and pending planner ticket longer than attempt lease but within total deadline; instrument unique predecessor event, operation lease/dispatch and all outbox tuples.
rows.stimulus: Commit waiting_external/release lease, settle, crash after prepare, then race old/current successors through prepared takeover and atomic consumption.
rows.expected: No live wait lease; operation stays accepted; active old owner blocks takeover, dead old owner is fenced by one generation-advancing prepared→prepared CAS, and only the exact current tuple atomically consumes/applies once.
rows.wrong_effect_absent: No false success, stuck lease, takeover while lease/dispatch is live, old-owner consume, consumed row without directive projection, duplicate attempt/directive, or cell-bound planner authority.

rows.title: Settled planner receipt authorizes directive
rows.setup: Fixtures for exact frozen caller states settled_success, settled_failure, cancelled_certain, cancelled_before_send, cancel_requested, outcome_unknown and quarantined, plus route/usage/owner/digest/budget/fence mutations.
rows.stimulus: Project caller settlement, inspect suspension and successor outbox, then attempt planner preparation/consumption.
rows.expected: Only settled_success, settled_failure and cancelled_certain create one outbox; eligible exact evidence may project once and absent usage stays null. Before-send cancellation uses outer finalization; uncertain/parked states remain outbox-free and reconcile-owned.
rows.wrong_effect_absent: No outbox for cancelled_before_send/cancel_requested/outcome_unknown/quarantined, no workspace mutation from stale/invalid evidence, no synthetic settlement digest and no null-usage zero-imputation.

rows.title: Recovery planner no-replay
rows.setup: Certain pre-cell checkpoint and committed worker loss with failed source digest.
rows.stimulus: Return same-source and new continuation directives.
rows.expected: Same source conflicts; new bounded continuation may proceed.
rows.wrong_effect_absent: No arbitrary stack serialization or automatic failed-cell replay.

rows.title: Exhaustive planner non-success convergence
rows.setup: Fixtures for valid/invalid settled_success, settled_failure, cancelled_certain, cancelled_before_send, cancel_requested, outcome_unknown, quarantined, cancel/deadline races and dead prepared owners.
rows.stimulus: Attempt outbox creation, successor prepare/takeover/consume, outer cancellation finalization and reconciliation for every frozen state.
rows.expected: Only settled_success/settled_failure/cancelled_certain create and consume one successor outbox; cancelled_before_send finalizes outside planner successor; cancel_requested/outcome_unknown/quarantined remain outbox-free reconcile-only; takeover fences stale owners.
rows.wrong_effect_absent: No ineligible outbox, invalid directive mutation, unknown-to-certain promotion, blind resend, synthetic settlement digest, duplicate event, stuck eligible known outcome or cell-bound planner access.

rows.title: Method-scoped admission
rows.setup: Partial profiles and model-only, artifact, and subagent budget variants.
rows.stimulus: Submit each job against each profile.
rows.expected: Model-only accepts on model profile; artifact/subagent variants require their exact methods.
rows.wrong_effect_absent: No global all-six requirement and no admission missing a required method.

rows.title: Optional unavailable call containment
rows.setup: Admitted profile omits optional evidence/effect method; planner attempts the call.
rows.stimulus: Execute through broker facade.
rows.expected: Certain capability-unavailable failure before caller ticket/send.
rows.wrong_effect_absent: No physical call, proposal, or hidden fallback adapter.

rows.title: Exact Luna/max positive qualification
rows.setup: Frozen activated candidate and separately authorized trivial qualification request.
rows.stimulus: Service exactly one AAR model.request ticket.
rows.expected: AAR route_qualification is aar_live_qualified only when provider/model/reasoning/fallback/cache are all attested and usage is request_receipt/complete from exact lineage; alias or capability metadata alone leaves individual components requested_only and insufficient.
rows.wrong_effect_absent: No capability-tier promotion, component collapse, fallback/effort drift, second send, estimated usage, or benchmark admission without classification digest.

rows.title: Route receipt negative matrix
rows.setup: Provider/model/effort/profile/catalog/fallback/adapter drift observations.
rows.stimulus: Project strict evaluator classifications from each receipt/native observation variant.
rows.expected: Each component independently yields attested, observed, requested_only or contradicted with exact effective/null and source rules; route qualification derives deterministically, including the valid Prime observed-provider/model plus requested-only-reasoning mix.
rows.wrong_effect_absent: No inferred effective component, whole-route collapse, capability evidence upgrade, omitted contradiction component, directive, or success from contradicted/insufficient evidence.

rows.title: Usage evidence and null semantics
rows.setup: Provider-reported, estimated, missing, partial reasoning/cache, and arithmetic mismatch observations.
rows.stimulus: Project strict usage/visibility classifications and benchmark rows.
rows.expected: request_receipt requires provider-reported complete per-attempt rows; aggregate/partial/unavailable remain lower tiers and nullable.
rows.wrong_effect_absent: No estimated-as-authoritative usage, partial-to-request promotion, invented zero, hidden retry, or double counting.

rows.title: Send-start and unknown outcome
rows.setup: Crashes before send-start, after send-start, after provider response, after candidate commit, plus deadline sweeps of outcome_unknown and quarantined tickets.
rows.stimulus: Restart and reconcile with lookup supported/unsupported variants, then advance the cumulative deadline.
rows.expected: Only certain pre-send work retries; sent ambiguity looks up, settles, or remains outcome-unknown/quarantined until authoritative evidence.
rows.wrong_effect_absent: No blind duplicate send, stale late-writer terminal overwrite, or deadline conversion of possibly-sent work into certain terminal truth.

rows.title: Frozen capability/caller-work/registry-v6 byte compatibility
rows.setup: The four predecessor inputs: v7 capability schema, v8 broker catalog, caller-work schema and migration-v6 SQL; plus operation-event/attempt/lease/dispatch and planner field-access canaries.
rows.stimulus: Byte/digest compare and inspect suspension/outbox/event/attempt/lease/dispatch/attempt-authority/rebind owners; exercise pending prepare, prepared takeover and atomic consume.
rows.expected: All predecessor bytes remain exact; suspension cell stays nullable, outbox legally supports full prepared tuple replacement/generation advance and atomic consume, predecessor maps through one existing waiting event, cell authority/rebind cells stay NOT NULL, and planner uses only existing cell-free owners.
rows.wrong_effect_absent: No schema/DDL/tool mutation, synthetic cell, invented predecessor key, planner cell-bound access, sidecar authority, reordered/extra tool or omitted takeover fence.

rows.title: Compatibility startup versus supplied-invalid activated startup
rows.setup: Exact wheel on v5 and v6 roots with no activation-profile path, then with supplied absent/malformed/stale/mismatching profile bytes.
rows.stimulus: Start supervisor/MCP through compatibility and activated-start paths; inspect construction, generation, listener, Ready, grants, capabilities and operations.
rows.expected: No-profile startup preserves v0.5 behavior and truthful unconfigured/reference rows with no auto-migration or mutation grant; any supplied-invalid profile rejects before host construction, generation, listener or Ready.
rows.wrong_effect_absent: No compatibility regression, profile synthesis, migration, runtime-generation allocation on supplied-invalid input, grant, operation, ticket or provider call.

rows.title: CLI mutation boundary
rows.setup: Command parser and filesystem/service/DB canaries.
rows.stimulus: Run every aar-admin subcommand with help, valid, invalid, and interrupted inputs.
rows.expected: Plan/status/verify are stdout/read-only; only explicit apply, abort, reconcile, permitted pre-frontier restore and runtime initialize reach their named mutation paths after final validation.
rows.wrong_effect_absent: No implicit service control, prompt-default mutation, plan --output write, or mutation by status/plan/verify.

rows.title: Credential and secret canaries
rows.setup: Canary secrets in environment/driver; prohibited semantic command/endpoint/import/credential fields; allowed opaque identifiers containing punctuation; all generated profiles/receipts/logs/package assets.
rows.stimulus: Run contract/activation/failure paths; inspect recursive schema-property inventories and imports; scan bounded outputs for known canary bytes without classifying permitted identifier contents.
rows.expected: No prohibited semantic field, runtime/provider transport import, expansion/execution behavior, or canary credential byte appears; permitted identifiers remain inert data.
rows.wrong_effect_absent: No token/key/cookie, credential-bearing command or endpoint field, environment expansion, URL/import resolution, execution behavior, or false rejection based only on permitted identifier contents.

rows.title: Immutable exact-wheel acceptance batch
rows.setup: Frozen source/wheel/profile/skill/contracts, preserved-v5 root, absent/uninitialized empty-runtime bootstrap root, independent reviewer.
rows.stimulus: Run all mandatory T0-T3 rows and compatibility/full-suite policy once on final bytes.
rows.expected: Every mandatory row and provenance/readback reconciles, both roots end through the same truthful frozen-v6 attestation/cutover receipt authority, and review threshold passes.
rows.wrong_effect_absent: No source import leakage, drift, selective rerun overwrite, T4 inference, publish, or release claim beyond evidence.

rows.title: Qualification accounting separation
rows.setup: Explicit T4 authority, frozen candidate, qualification IDs, empty benchmark runs.
rows.stimulus: Run the authorized positive/negative route qualifications.
rows.expected: AAR is aar_live_qualified with five attested route components and request-level usage; Prime is prime_live_qualified only with native-observed provider/model/fallback/cache, no contradiction, and reasoning explicitly requested_only/null or stronger. Requested-only Prime provider/model remains blocked from T5.
rows.wrong_effect_absent: No benchmark attempt ID, formal score, silent rerun, or release T0-T3 promotion.

rows.title: Claim-state separation
rows.setup: All possible combinations of spec, implementation, T0-T3, T4, and T5 evidence.
rows.stimulus: Render status/readme/roadmap/release claims.
rows.expected: Only the highest fully evidenced status is shown with blockers and non-claims.
rows.wrong_effect_absent: No planning-as-implementation, tests-as-live-route, qualification-as-benchmark, or historical receipt rewrite.

rows.title: Native and caller planner separation
rows.setup: Two separately digested activation profiles: caller_delegated_ticketed with a caller_driver model.request manifest and service_managed with a native model.request manifest; caller_delegated/service_managed matching and cross-mismatching jobs.
rows.stimulus: Resolve each profile through the immutable method factory registry, normalize job execution mode, project planner readback, then run both matches and cross-mismatches.
rows.expected: Only caller_delegated→caller_delegated_ticketed and service_managed→service_managed accept the exact profile-bound model.request factory/manifest; caller mode also requires start_only.
rows.wrong_effect_absent: No raw-string equality bug, per-request mode switching, second constructor namespace, arbitrary import, cross-kind false green, borrowed liveness, operation creation on mismatch, or provider send.

rows.title: Complete budget/grant/method implication cross-product
rows.setup: Both separately digested caller_delegated_ticketed/caller_driver and service_managed/native model.request profiles; table rows vary max_artifact_count, max_artifact_bytes, require_named_artifacts, max_subagent_calls, model.request/artifact.put/subagent.submit/subagent.result/evidence.query/effect.propose grant subsets, zero/nonzero budgets, coherent/conflicting grant unions, retired factory/profile/digest and same-generation instantiated-adapter health.
rows.stimulus: Before operation creation, normalize planner mode, resolve the coherent grant union, derive the exact required executable-method set for every row, and test missing, reference-only, stale, contract-mismatched and unhealthy method owners.
rows.expected: Mode requires the matching model.request owner; any artifact count/bytes/named-artifact trigger requires artifact.put; any subagent budget or either subagent capability requires both subagent.submit and subagent.result; evidence.query/effect.propose are required exactly when granted; zero budget adds no authority. Missing/implied-ungranted, conflicting union, mode or retired factory/profile/digest fails GRANT_DENIED; only valid-current-grant same-generation instantiated-adapter health loss is CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE.
rows.wrong_effect_absent: No raw mode-only false green, omitted artifact/subagent implication, one-sided subagent owner, optional-grant borrowing, zero-budget authority expansion, cross-profile/factory borrowing, operation creation, provider send or unrelated method requirement.

rows.title: Authority-versus-current adapter availability discriminator
rows.setup: Job feature implies a method under absent capability; then use valid current grants while the instantiated same-generation adapter health becomes unavailable; separately drift factory/profile bytes so generation is retired.
rows.stimulus: Run pre-operation admission in each state.
rows.expected: Missing entitlement and retired/stale factory authority serialize as frozen-v8 GRANT_DENIED; valid current authority plus same-generation instantiated-adapter health loss is CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE.
rows.wrong_effect_absent: No AUTHORITY_DENIED wire literal, impossible stale-factory/current-grant state, operation row, ticket, workspace mutation, grant widening or provider send.

rows.title: Prime provider alias qualification
rows.setup: Frozen Prime executable/config/model registry and credential-resolver identity; no credential bytes.
rows.stimulus: Build and validate provider-alias attestation, then launch one authorized Luna/max qualification.
rows.expected: Digest-bound alias attestation normalizes requested provider identity only; absent stock effective provider/model leaves those components requested_only and route_qualification=insufficient, not prime_live_qualified.
rows.wrong_effect_absent: No automatic hermes-codex=openai-codex claim, hidden fallback, credential capture, or effective-effort promotion from flags.

rows.title: Prime usage scope and arithmetic
rows.setup: One authorized Prime qualification with stock JSON/events preserved.
rows.stimulus: Classify request rows or session aggregate and verify nonnegative values, scope, totals, and null dimensions.
rows.expected: Evidence is request_receipt, session_aggregate, partial_events, or unavailable exactly as stock data supports.
rows.wrong_effect_absent: No synthetic request IDs, zero-imputed missing dimensions, aggregate-to-request promotion, or hidden retry claim.

rows.title: Sole paired-planning machine row; no T5 execution authority
rows.setup: Exact planning fixtures for both classified arms plus candidate/profile/alias/case/protocol/budget/stop-matrix digests, planning authority and arm order; mutate every binding and probe every package surface.
rows.stimulus: Validate/build benchmark_ready_planned and attempt any paired launch, attempt allocation, machine stop action, score, rerun or expansion.
rows.expected: Only exact planning bytes validate; no T5 rows or launcher consumer exist, no attempt is allocated, and all provider/contender send canaries remain zero.
rows.wrong_effect_absent: No executable paired block, benchmark_ready_authorized status, attempt allocation, machine stop action, max-request claim, hidden rerun, score, comparison, winner, provider call or contender start.
rows.evidence_class: sole paired-planning no-launch schema negative gate

rows.title: Empty-runtime v5 bootstrap then separately materialized ordinary cutover
rows.setup: Absent, exact uninitialized and canonical-empty-v5 disposable registries; caught pre/post-commit fault injection; abrupt pre-commit SIGKILL residue fixture; exact candidate/intent and separately emitted ordinary cutover plan.
rows.stimulus: Run runtime initialize through caught faults and reruns; classify abrupt crash-left WAL/SHM residue; then separately plan/apply only from a clean canonical empty-v5 root.
rows.expected: Caught faults converge to canonical empty v5 and stop with migration_required. Abrupt residue fails UNINITIALIZED_RUNTIME_RESIDUE with zero delete/checkpoint/adoption/retry. Only a separately retained plan enters ordinary cutover.
rows.wrong_effect_absent: No abrupt-crash convergence claim, automatic sidecar recovery, in-memory cutover plan, initialization epoch/marker/receipt, direct-v6 path, non-empty-v5 acceptance, history fork or Ready before terminal equality.

rows.title: Pre-frontier restore with cross-epoch terminal closure
rows.setup: Verified snapshot, original cutover prepared marker and exact cutover_aborted or cutover_recovery_required terminal marker, plus allowed/forbidden frontier and WAL/SHM variants.
rows.stimulus: Attempt restore under exclusive lock; vary original terminal digest, duplicate/missing successor and crash before/after restore terminal publication.
rows.expected: Allowed restore preparation/receipt binds the exact original cutover terminal digest and restore_committed closes one matching recovery-required cutover; forbidden, missing, duplicate or mismatched closure remains startup-blocking.
rows.wrong_effect_absent: No dangling unmatched cutover, stale sidecar, success receipt on failure, marker rewrite, down migration or post-frontier replacement.

rows.title: Acyclic prepared/receipt/terminal marker authority
rows.setup: Generate cutover and restore plan/snapshot/prepared/receipt/terminal fixtures plus snapshot-before-prepared crash fixtures.
rows.stimulus: Recompute inner/outer digests, swap/tamper receipts and markers, reuse epoch with changed bytes, and exercise exact snapshot adoption versus mismatch.
rows.expected: Only plan→prepared→transaction/receipt→terminal validates; exact orphan snapshot can be adopted once; every cycle, swap, duplicate terminal or changed-input epoch conflicts.
rows.wrong_effect_absent: No self-digest fixed point, receipt that embeds its terminal marker, ambiguous snapshot deletion/overwrite, DB mutation, or false committed status.
